teachingComponents.title: Cell types, structure/function and images
teachingComponents.brief: Extend existing text to explicitly identify animal/plant cells as eukaryotic, bacterial single DNA loop and relative size; complete organelle functions including cellulose wall support, vacuole/cell sap and algal cells. Reuse photosynthesis chloroplast/chlorophyll explanation. Extend animal and bacterium art/labels to match all claimed structures; add one reusable plant-cell schematic. Distinguish schematic structures from what a light microscope can actually resolve. Put quantitative scale explanations in T3, not here.

teachingComponents.title: Specialisation structure-to-function comparison
teachingComponents.brief: Retain sperm/root-hair examples. Add nerve and muscle and xylem/phloem adaptation-to-function links. Reuse existing plant transport functions and root-hair active-transport explanation; do not teach plant transport again. Include inference from supplied unfamiliar-cell features.

teachingComponents.title: Microscopy, scale and quantitative reasoning
teachingComponents.brief: Extend existing equation/resolution explanation with light-to-electron development, magnification versus resolving power, both rearrangements, centi/milli/micro/nano conversions, standard form, orders of magnitude, estimation of size/area and why estimation is suitable. Reuse existing division examples, card equation flow and Learning Lab. Supply a shared labelled image/scale context for several questions, not a new image per question.

teachingComponents.title: Chromosomes, differentiation and the three-stage cell cycle
teachingComponents.brief: Reference existing Inheritance DNA/chromosome explanation and paired chromosomes; add only explicit many-genes-per-chromosome link if source review confirms it is not stated. Extend division explanation with growth and increased organelles, chromosome copying, separation/nuclear division and final cytoplasm/membrane division. Reuse card flow for the three overall stages; no named mitotic phases required. Add animal early differentiation versus lifelong plant differentiation, mature animal repair/replacement and acquisition of specialised sub-cellular structures. Reuse the existing non-AQA Growth and differentiation clause only after explicit shared-AQA mapping; do not import its unrelated brain/eye content.

teachingComponents.title: Stem-cell sources and applications
teachingComponents.brief: Extend current embryonic/adult comparison with source/function of adult bone marrow and plant meristems, lifelong plant potential, diabetes/paralysis applications, therapeutic cloning/rejection, viral-transfer risk and balanced ethics. Add rare-plant conservation and crop-cloning purposes. Retain existing tumour/rejection warning and benefit/risk question; do not require laboratory stem-cell techniques.

teachingComponents.title: RP01 observations and practical support
teachingComponents.brief: Consolidate existing slide/stain/coverslip/focus material with practical record. Extend to suitable prepared/fresh plant and animal specimens, appropriate stain choice under school protocol, safe slide/coverslip/stain handling, illumination/coarse/fine focus and lens/specimen protection, comparison of observations, labelled proportional drawings and a magnification scale. Include a model observation/drawing checklist and shared scale calculation from T3. Distinguish an unchloroplasted onion epidermis from a photosynthetic plant cell. No new simulation or UI redesign.
